simulator.subtitle: Adjust to simulate impact of additional discount. Pareto frontier gap shown live.
simulator.insightMargin: Margin-protection mode. At {{discount}}% discount, you're {{gap}}pp below the Pareto frontier. Win probability gain is minimal — this is the Nash-optimal zone.
simulator.insightBalanced: Balanced trade-off. Adding {{additional}}pp discount yields +{{winDelta}}pp win probability — a sub-linear return. Consider non-monetary concessions first.
simulator.insightSacrifice: Margin sacrifice territory. Further discounting beyond {{discount}}% shows strong diminishing returns on win probability. Game-theory analysis suggests a switch to strategic concessions (POC, implementation credits) instead.

ma-sf-1.title: Escalate to Executive Sponsor
ma-sf-1.description: Bring your VP Sales or CRO into the next meeting to signal commitment and unlock procurement authority.
ma-sf-1.rationale: Deals with exec-to-exec engagement close 2.3× faster vs Salesforce in this ARR band. Competitor rep is junior — exploit asymmetry.

ma-sf-2.title: Invoke Implementation Speed
ma-sf-2.description: Offer a 6-week go-live guarantee with dedicated onboarding. Contrast Salesforce's avg 22-week implementation.
ma-sf-2.rationale: Time-to-value is the #1 differentiator in 67% of SF displacement wins. Prospect has a Q3 board deadline creating urgency.

ma-sf-3.title: Deploy ROI Calculator with CFO Data
ma-sf-3.description: Send the custom ROI model pre-loaded with their industry benchmarks and current stack cost analysis.
ma-sf-3.rationale: CFO is the economic buyer. SF's TCO is 40% higher over 3 years. Surface this now before SF submits their commercial proposal.

ma-sf-4.title: Reduce Discount to 12% — Hold Margin
ma-sf-4.description: Trim current discount offer from 16% to 12%. Use saved margin as negotiation reserve for professional services.
ma-sf-4.rationale: You are above the Nash equilibrium discount (16%). Incremental win probability gain per point above 12% is near-zero. Protect margin now.

ma-hs-1.title: Champion the RevOps Depth Narrative
ma-hs-1.description: Run a 45-min live walkthrough of pipeline analytics, forecasting CI, and scenario modelling vs HubSpot's native reporting.
ma-hs-1.rationale: HubSpot loses on forecasting sophistication in 72% of RevOps-led evaluations. Your prospect's RevOps Director has been active in Slack.

ma-hs-2.title: Offer Data Migration White Glove
ma-hs-2.description: Provide free, zero-risk HubSpot CRM data migration as part of onboarding. Use this as a switching-cost neutraliser.
ma-hs-2.rationale: Migration anxiety is HubSpot's strongest retention lever. Removing it collapses a key defection barrier and signals confidence.

ma-hs-3.title: Lock In Multi-Year with Price Protection
ma-hs-3.description: Propose a 2-year deal with CPI-cap on Year 2 pricing. HubSpot just raised prices 18% — use this as an anchor.
ma-hs-3.rationale: Price stability is a top 3 concern for 61% of HubSpot replacements. A pricing lock converts a short-term win into long-term retention.

ma-hs-4.title: Introduce Reference Customer (Same Vertical)
ma-hs-4.description: Arrange a 30-min reference call with Nexus Health — same healthcare vertical, comparable ARR, direct HubSpot switcher.
ma-hs-4.rationale: Social proof from same-vertical peers reduces perceived risk by 44% and increases urgency. Nexus Health NPS: 9.

ma-ms-1.title: Unbundle from Azure — Standalone TCO Attack
ma-ms-1.description: Present an independent TCO analysis showing Microsoft's true cost when Dynamics is decoupled from their Azure commitment.
ma-ms-1.rationale: MS reps bundle to obscure per-unit cost. Isolating Dynamics pricing exposes a 35% premium vs Predicto. CFO is the ally here.

ma-ms-2.title: Exploit Implementation Timeline Weakness
ma-ms-2.description: Request that Microsoft commits to a go-live timeline in writing. Their avg is 9+ months — your guarantee is 45 days.
ma-ms-2.rationale: Prospect has announced a Q4 revenue operations overhaul. MS cannot match your deployment velocity. Create a hard deadline commitment.

ma-ms-3.title: Propose Parallel Pilot — Lower Risk Barrier
ma-ms-3.description: Offer a 60-day paid pilot on a single business unit while existing M365 stack remains in place. Zero displacement risk.
ma-ms-3.rationale: Microsoft's procurement requires multi-quarter approvals. A pilot bypasses this gate and creates internal proof points within their own org.

ma-ms-4.title: Engage IT Stakeholder with Security Narrative
ma-ms-4.description: Schedule dedicated CISO/IT Director call focused on SOC 2 Type II, GDPR coverage, and data residency controls.
ma-ms-4.rationale: Microsoft wins on perceived security credibility. Pre-emptively close this objection before IT is pulled into the eval process.
